verdicts.quote: an authorised user finds "Grok Bot" through the App Launcher and opens the chat page at `/lightning/n/Grok_Bot`. ... Out of scope: Experience Cloud, mobile-publisher branding, record pages, utility bar, console app, Classic.
(b) Sharing: not applicable by design: the bot reads no records (PD-8); AD-6 still selects the safe sharing default for the server code so a later record read inherits it.
(c) Object CRUD and (d) field-level security: not applicable by design: no SOQL/DML on org data.
only a user holding the access grant can run the send operation; the grant bundles the tab, the app, the platform-boundary classes and the credential-principal access (AD-4).
verdicts.missing: Who may administer the bot (enter key, edit settings) is just 'Org administrator'; no permission set or specific permission defines bot administration.

verdicts.quote: Transcript and history | the open component, memory | only that user's page; never sent to another user's client ... stored nowhere by the product, and are not logged (R-12).
Order inside one transaction: read settings, build body, make the callout. No DML precedes the callout (a callout after uncommitted work in the same transaction is disallowed [S])
verdicts.missing: The spec deliberately chooses a synchronous imperative callout and rejects Queueable/async (AD-7); the asynchronous design the nuance requires is not adopted.

verdicts.quote: the xAI API key is stored only in the org's credential facility (AD-3), entered by a person in Setup. It is never in source control, deployed metadata, a custom setting/metadata record, ... a log line or a test fixture.

cumulative callout time per transaction is capped at 120 seconds; one callout's timeout ranges from 1 ms to 120,000 ms ... at most 100 callouts per transaction. Heap limit for synchronous Apex (6 MB) [U].
verdicts.missing: CPU time limit is not named or given a number.

verdicts.quote: Apex tests use `HttpCalloutMock`; a mock proves the parse/classify/request-shape logic, not xAI's behavior or the credential.
Named Credential `Grok_API` (URL `https://api.x.ai`) ... (c) no Remote Site Setting is needed for a Named Credential endpoint
the component calls `sendMessage` imperatively and awaits the promise.
verdicts.missing: The answer is assumed to return inline from a synchronous call; no platform event, CDC, polled status or message-service notification mechanism is specified.

verdicts.quote: Idempotency/duplicates | double-submit is prevented client-side (R-10); the server has no dedupe, a repeat call is a new billable call by design
synchronous request/response; no acceptance-without-result ... no queue, no worker, so no abandoned-work recovery
verdicts.missing: Concurrent request limits (e.g. concurrent long-running synchronous Apex requests from several users) and the outcome when one is refused are not stated.

verdicts.quote: `E-AUTH` xAI answered 401 or 403; `E-RATE` xAI answered 429; `E-TIMEOUT` no answer within the configured timeout; ... `E-UPSTREAM` xAI answered 5xx ... Each class has its own visible text
Transient-group errors offer Retry ... retry is user-initiated only (PD-4) ... Out of scope: automatic retry/backoff
if the call never returns, the platform timeout (R-9) ends it as E-TIMEOUT; the pending state is never left forever.
verdicts.missing: Handling of a partial or truncated (incomplete) answer that does contain some text is undecided; AD-2 leaves 'whether an incomplete status exists' unverified.

verdicts.quote: Conversations are not persisted anywhere in the org (R-8).
verdicts.missing: No stored record shape (role, status, timestamps, model id, token/usage counts) is defined; the spec deliberately stores nothing.

verdicts.quote: Leaving the page, reloading, or closing the tab ends the conversation permanently; nothing is stored in the org or in browser storage.

The bot does not read Salesforce records (no CRM grounding, no actions on data). ... a notice that messages are sent to xAI (Grok) ... users should not enter information they may not share with that provider.
The window is `History_Window` messages (default 20, PD-3). When history plus the new message exceeds the window, the oldest complete turns ... are dropped
a message that is empty or only whitespace is not sent ... exactly 4,000 characters is accepted; 4,001 is rejected.
an administrator edits, without a code change or deploy, `Model` (text) ... The next send uses the new values.
verdicts.missing: No explicit admin off switch, and no admin view of failed requests beyond optional platform debug logs of the R-12 diagnostic line.

verdicts.quote: The product emits no diagnostic that contains message text, reply text, the system prompt, the key or an xAI response body.
verdicts.missing: No audit record of who asked what and what was answered, nor its retention; the spec deliberately keeps none.

verdicts.quote: target is a development org only (a Developer Edition, sandbox or scratch org). A production org is refused ... a deploy validation (`sf project deploy validate`) before the real deploy
verdicts.missing: How configuration and credential differ per environment, and the production code-coverage requirement, are not stated.

verdicts.quote: the UI shows a pending state: Send disabled ... 'Grok is thinking'. The pending state ends only when the call returns or fails, never on a timer ... timeout 60,000 ms
a deliberately designed chat interface ... designed empty, loading, error, not-ready and success states
the bot's metadata is delivered to one named development org, additively: pre-existing components, fields, automation and access in that org are unchanged.
